'''Darth Nihilus' lightsaber''' was the personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]]. It was destroyed onboard the Ravager following Nihilus' confrontation with [[Meetra Surik]], [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]], and his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Visas Marr]].<ref name="KOTOR II" />
